patthana15.45:1.1: Cittānuparivattiṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana15.45:2.1: Cittānuparivattiṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava. (Abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇiyeva paccayavasena.)
